verdict.rationale: The only documented versioning touches one kind of automation: scouts. Self-driving scouts are skills, and skills keep immutable versions on every edit, with base_version concurrency checks, so the definitions behind the scouts are versioned and editable. PostHog's main automation surfaces, Workflows and the Hog-function CDP pipelines and destinations, are documented only as editable and testable, with no evidence of version history or rollback. Missing for 10: version history for Workflows and CDP pipelines, an explicit rollback or restore-previous-version capability, a review/approval step for automation changes (PR review covers agent code output, not automation definitions), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
